payload.release_notes:
- A print job stays Pending until an eligible remote Network PC displays it. The designer PC cannot acknowledge its own job.
- Each authorized printer can download an original on demand. An interrupted transfer leaves the job available to other printers.
- Verified download receipts and exact roll manifests let another printer complete the correct job by moving its downloaded file or generated roll into Old Download.
- Each source tracks the roll parts that contain it, so archiving an unrelated roll leaves the other jobs in their correct states.
